name: Testimonials Results
description: A warm testimonial band: a left column with heading, two stats and a case-studies link, a middle column of two quotes with authors, and a right real portrait photo in a tinted glass frame.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the three columns fade up staggered (wpmn-tr-up 600ms, 90/180ms)
the portrait bleeds past the section padding with a warm warning-tint overlay
prefers-reduced-motion: content rendered in place, no animation
